core_questions: Who owns Puerto Rico's economic assets?
Who finances, operates and controls those assets?
Where does capital originate, circulate and ultimately accumulate?
Who benefits from government expenditures, contracts, subsidies and incentives?
What financial dependencies exist between public, private, domestic and foreign entities?
How have these relationships changed historically?

foundations.name: Identity adjudication
foundations.role: The only engine allowed to decide that two source manifestations are the same entity. Candidate sets, contradictions and SUPERSEDED observations are preserved.

foundations.name: Entity-network kernel
foundations.role: Typed non-monetary relationships, N:N sector membership and the boundary that keeps dependency edges from becoming payment evidence.

foundations.name: Source-preserving financial observation
foundations.role: Exact-decimal amounts bound to source row identity, original byte hash, accounting measure, period, basis and currency.

foundations.name: Legacy flow compatibility
foundations.role: Read-only bridge from legacy random flow_id rows to source-bound observations; unbound rows stay UNRESOLVED.

foundations.name: Government entity registry
foundations.role: Type, identifier-scheme and succession vocabulary for Puerto Rico public entities, including predecessor/successor and operator/concessionaire relations.

foundations.name: Federal financial ontology
foundations.role: Namespaced program / award / action / subaward / account identifiers for federal money.

foundations.name: Source registry and readiness ledger
foundations.role: The registered source denominator and its materialization state.

foundations.name: Canonical transaction identity and domain projection
foundations.role: One identity per underlying transaction, independent of how many domains it appears in.

foundations.name: Temporal ownership model
foundations.role: Dated ownership and control intervals with unknown owners preserved and parent kept distinct from beneficial owner.

foundations.name: Corporate continuity model
foundations.role: Seven independent status dimensions; no dimension is inferred from another.

flow_model.note: The eight flow kinds are not one exclusive list. Three describe where money moves relative to Puerto Rico and exclude one another; five describe what kind of movement it is and can combine with any direction.

entity_universe.restriction: Relevant, lawfully accessible information only. No home address, identity number, family, health or other sensitive personal field is admitted.

historical_scope.earlier_evidence: Admitted only with a recorded justification that it establishes relevant ownership or institutional continuity.

capabilities.name: Ultimate ownership resolution
capabilities.guardrail: Traversal stops at an unresolved holder and reports it; an intermediate holder is never reported as ultimate.

capabilities.name: Beneficial ownership analysis
capabilities.guardrail: Only BENEFICIAL intervals with binding evidence count. A parent company is not a beneficial owner.

capabilities.name: Capital flow reconstruction
capabilities.guardrail: Awards, ceilings and approvals are not cash movements.

capabilities.name: Ownership concentration
capabilities.guardrail: Requires a certified sector denominator; a partial corpus yields no concentration figure.

capabilities.name: Geographic concentration
capabilities.purpose: Identify municipal and regional investment patterns
capabilities.guardrail: Headquarters location is not the place of performance.

capabilities.name: Government exposure
capabilities.guardrail: State ownership must be documented per interval; it is never inferred from a name or country.

capabilities.name: Economic dependency
capabilities.guardrail: A dependency edge is not evidence of payment.

capabilities.name: Contract network analysis
capabilities.guardrail: Correlation is never promoted to causation, coordination, misconduct or proof of control.

capabilities.name: Corporate genealogy
capabilities.guardrail: Possible successors stay possible until a binding record names them.

capabilities.name: Asset lifecycle tracking
capabilities.purpose: Track ownership and operation over time
capabilities.guardrail: Continued operation of an asset does not show continued operation of its owner.

capabilities.name: Political-financial correlation
capabilities.purpose: Examine disclosed financial and political relationships
capabilities.guardrail: Correlation is never promoted to causation, coordination, misconduct or proof of control.

capabilities.name: Revolving-door analysis
capabilities.purpose: Track documented employment and appointment transitions
capabilities.guardrail: Only documented roles with dates. Name matches alone are not identity.

capabilities.name: Related-party transactions
capabilities.purpose: Identify disclosed transactions between connected entities
capabilities.guardrail: The relationship and the transaction are evidenced separately.

capabilities.name: Offshore network analysis
capabilities.guardrail: A foreign or offshore jurisdiction is a fact about registration, not a risk finding.

capabilities.name: Bankruptcy asset tracing
capabilities.guardrail: Unresolved asset ownership stays unresolved.

capabilities.name: Revenue distribution
capabilities.purpose: Identify documented beneficiaries of economic activity
capabilities.guardrail: Gross revenue is not distributed profit.

capabilities.name: Public expenditure tracing
capabilities.guardrail: Obligated, disbursed and expended are different measures and are never summed together.

capabilities.name: Historical comparison
capabilities.guardrail: Periods overlap by design; comparisons state valuation basis and price year.

capabilities.name: Contradiction detection
capabilities.purpose: Identify conflicting financial and ownership disclosures
capabilities.guardrail: Both sides of a conflict are preserved; neither is silently chosen.

capabilities.name: Change detection
capabilities.purpose: Detect new transactions, ownership and institutional changes
capabilities.guardrail: A change in a source is not by itself a change in the world.

source_authority_hierarchy.description: Source-native official record with a stable identifier: statutory registry entry, regulatory filing, court docket, recorded instrument, signed contract.
Official government dataset or publication derived from primary records, with row identity.
Self-disclosure by a regulated entity: audited statements, official statements, annual reports.
Operational or infrastructure documentation from an agency or operator.
Press, research and other secondary analysis.

source_authority_rules: A lower rank never overrides a higher rank; a disagreement is kept as a contradiction.
Ranks 5 and 6 are discovery leads only. They never establish identity, ownership or an amount.
Two sources of the same rank that disagree leave the fact UNRESOLVED.
Absence from a source is not evidence of absence.

scope_policy.policy: Puerto Rico and demonstrably connected external entities
Lawfully accessible financial, corporate and government records
Disclosed amounts with explicit valuation basis

prohibitions: MoneySweep is not an unrestricted general-purpose surveillance system.
MoneySweep does not duplicate asset registries owned by other federation repositories.
Ordinary foreign economic activity is not treated as suspicious.
Correlation is never automatically promoted to causation, coordination, misconduct or proof of control.
